name: Remi Edelstahl Tubulars Limited
about: Remi Edelstahl Tubulars Limited manufactures and sells stainless steel pipes and tubes in India. The company offers welded and seamless cold finish tubes; electric fusion welded pipes; TIG welded and seamless pipes and tubes; and welded condenser and feed water heater tubes for power plants. The company offers products for various industries, such as stainless steel pipes and tubes for diverse applications in industries such as oil and gas, petrochemicals, thermal and nuclear power, food processing, pharmaceuticals, defence, water treatment, data processing, and processed food storage. It also exports its products. The company was formerly known as Rajendra Mechanical Industries Ltd. and changed its name to Remi Edelstahl Tubulars Limited in November 2009. Remi Edelstahl Tubulars Limited was incorporated in 1970 and is headquartered in Mumbai, India.
